_comment: Translation table for the CK3 injection layer. These are DATA, not code, so a mod/version change is an edit here. Strings are string.Template templates (placeholders: $ref, $id, $target).
_provisional: The effect and trigger names below are UNVERIFIED. Only the M14 mechanism (hook, ?=, a stat modifier) has run in-game; the hard actions have never executed. Validate every name against a script_docs dump (see ck3_strategist/validate.py) before relying on them. `start_war` in particular needs a casus_belli and usually a target_title. Readiness guarding is deliberately omitted here and will return with the standing-orders design (docs/roadmap.md, review v4).
